{{Quote|Tell Captain Kagi to prepare my shuttle for immediate takeoff.|Darth Sidious, to Mas Amedda|audio=CaptainKagi-RotS.flac|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
'''Kagi''' was an individual who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[captain]] and worked for the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]]. Soon after he [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] confronted Sidious in a [[Duel in the Galactic Senate|duel]] in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building's]] [[Galactic Senate Chamber]] on<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Timelines" /> [[Coruscant]]. Ending with Yoda fleeing the fight, Sidious soon [[Force sense|felt]] that his newly appointed [[Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] was in danger. The [[Sith Lord]] therefore ordered his [[advisor]] [[Mas Amedda]] to inform Kagi to prepare his [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]] for immediate takeoff to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Mustafar]], where his apprentice was [[Duel on Mustafar|battling]] Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kagi was mentioned in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" />
